Name: Brianalana's Trees Alternative Textures Version
Author: glymr
Description:
An Alternative Textures version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7521]Brianalana's Trees[/url]. Includes a purple pine tree ("firepine") and two mushroom trees ("flat" and "inkcap").

You can use the paint can (purchasable at Robin's) to change the texture of any pine tree to the firepine or any vanilla mushroom tree to either of the two variations from this mod.

If the "Random" option for trees is turned on in Alternative Textures, you'll also see some pines and mushroom trees with these textures starting to show up in the world. You won't see them immediately when installing on an existing save, but they'll start to show up occasionally when trees grow back after being cut down, new trees are planted, or when seasons change. Starting a brand new save with this mod installed and active (and the Random option for trees turned on in Alternative Textures) will cause some wild pines will show up as firepines.

The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7521]original Content Patcher version of the mod[/url] still works fine. It allows the player to change all vanilla wild trees to one of these textures (ie all oaks can look like the inkcap from this mod). If you prefer that behavior, you'll want to download the original mod instead and change the settings as desired using GMCM. I have fixed a small visual issue with the spring texture in the AT version.

Many thanks to brea83 for permission to create this new version of the mod!
